module: Module 2: MAM Allocation Methods & Sizing Engine
title: Proportional by Equity (PBE): Divergent Cash vs Floating Equity
precondition: Account 1: $10k cash / $12k equity; Account 2: $10k cash / $8k equity (Total Equity = $20k).
steps: 1. Master opens 2.00 lots USDJPY using PBE.
expected_result: Account 1 receives 2.00 * ($12k / $20k) = 1.20 lots; Account 2 receives 2.00 * ($8k / $20k) = 0.80 lots; sum == 2.00 lots.
actual_result: PBE sizing: Acc 1 = 1.2 lots, Acc 2 = 0.8 lots, total = 2.0 lots.
